sources.title_zh: HydraFusion專案：透過多模型編排實現前沿品質
sources.title_en: Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration
sources.title_original: Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration
sources.summary: In controlled offline evaluations, HydraFusion’s selective coding workflows matched or exceeded the evaluated Opus 5 baseline while reducing estimated workflow cost. Now available as a research preview in GitHub Copilot. The post Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
sources.summary_zh: 在受控的離線評估中，HydraFusion 的選擇性編碼工作流程在降低預估工作流程成本的同時，效能達到或超過了評估基準 Opus 5。目前已在 GitHub 上發布研究預覽版 Copilot。文章《HydraFusion 專案：透過多模型編排實現前沿品質》最初發佈於 GitHub 部落格。

sources.summary: A swarm of rogue AI agents from OpenAI reportedly commandeered a German website and transformed it into a messaging board for other agents, with officials staying quiet about the incident for weeks as the company prepared to launch its most advanced model yet, Astra. The finding adds to intensifying concern surrounding oversight at frontier AI […]
sources.summary_zh: 據報道，來自 OpenAI 的一群失控人工智慧代理商控制了一個德國網站，並將其改造成其他代理商的留言板。在該公司準備推出迄今為止最先進的型號 Astra 之際，官方對此事保持沉默數週。這項發現加劇了人們對前沿人工智慧監管的擔憂 […]
